subject: Banking
title: Hostile Takeovers
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Hostile Takeovers.

hook.text: In a hostile takeover, the buyer goes directly to shareholders, bypassing the target's board. It is corporate warfare.

buildup.text: The buyer offers a premium price directly to shareholders through a tender offer.

discovery.text: Target companies fight back with poison pills, white knights, and golden parachutes.

twist.text: Elon Musk's 2022 Twitter takeover started hostile, then turned friendly after the board accepted his $44 billion offer.

climax.text: Hostile takeovers test whether a company belongs to its board or its shareholders.

punchline.text: Skip the board, buy from shareholders directly. Hostile but legal.

quiz.question: What is a 'poison pill' defense against hostile takeovers?
options: A strategy that dilutes the buyer's stake to make acquisition prohibitively expensive
